# University of Central Missouri

> > University of Central Missouri (UCM) - A comprehensive public university in Missouri offering undergraduate and graduate programs with financial aid resources including FAFSA, Mule Grant, and Red and Black Scholarship.

UCM (also known as UCMO) is a Missouri-based university providing education across multiple departments including Music, Interior Design, and more. The site includes student resources, faculty profiles, and financial aid tools like the Scholarship Finder.

- [University of Central Missouri UCM Among Missouri's Best Universities](https://www.ucmo.edu/index.php): UCM homepage featuring FAFSA, Mule Grant, and scholarship information

## Web Templates and Components

- [Contact Information Template](https://www.ucmo.edu/_resources/snippets/contact.html): UCMO contact information template snippet for staff directory
- [Profile Template](https://www.ucmo.edu/_resources/snippets/profile.html): Faculty profile template for Dr. David Aaberg and Music Department staff
- [Accordion Component](https://www.ucmo.edu/_resources/snippets/accordion.html): Accordion UI component HTML markup template with placeholder content
- [Department Image Grid](https://www.ucmo.edu/_resources/snippets/department-image-grid.html): Department image grid layout template snippet for web design
- [Interior Page Template](https://www.ucmo.edu/_resources/img/interiorpage.html): UCMO interior page layout template with placeholder demonstration
